mentions.name: Kavla
mentions.description: Kavla is a canvas-based data workspace that lets users combine queries, charts, images, and notes on a single board instead of alt-tabbing between Slack, images, and separate query tools. Recent work improved the editor's 'flow' and added read-only shareable boards built with HMAC, nonces, and encryption.
mentions.problem: Data tools lack 'flow' — users have to alt-tab between Slack, images, and separate queries instead of working on one canvas.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still working on https://kavla.dev

I have worked with data for a while. I feel like our tools could be much better when it comes to "flow". I want an experience where you don't need to alt+tab to slack/images/another query. What if we put it all on a canvas? That's what Kavla is all about!
